name: first-round recommend_resources `needs` expectations v1
purpose: The expected FIRST-ROUND tool AND the expected `needs` argument of recommend_resources for every question below. Written and committed BEFORE any probe arm ran, so the expectations are not fit to results. Read by eval/tool-choice-probe.mjs (--expectations) and scored mechanically by eval/tool-choice-score.mjs (score + scoreNeeds).

labels.recommend_resources: Every question here is a 'which model for this kind of image' question, so the first round should call recommend_resources (same label and match rule as tool-choice-expectations.v1.json).

needsRule.capability question: expectedNeeds[id] is a NON-EMPTY any-of list. Met when the first round calls recommend_resources AND the union of its `needs` arguments contains at least one listed capability. Extra capabilities beside a listed one are allowed and reported separately as `extra`, not scored.
needsRule.none question: expectedNeeds[id] is []. Clean when the first round calls recommend_resources with `needs` absent or empty; NOISE when it passes any capability. A turn that does not call recommend_resources at all is a tool miss, reported in the tool-choice score and excluded from the needs denominator.
needsRule.unobserved: A turn cut off by max_tokens before any tool call is excluded and counted, as in v1.

extraQuestions.text: which model should I use to make a concert poster with the band name as a big headline?
what's a good model for designing a logo for my coffee shop
extraQuestions.why: Logo: a layout/design job that usually carries the shop's name.

extraQuestions.text: which model can mock up a mobile app UI screen for a fitness tracker

extraQuestions.why: No capability implied: a style/add-on question.

extraQuestions.text: what checkpoint should I use for epic fantasy landscapes
recommend some LoRAs for a watercolor painting style

notes.N2/N4: Two capabilities are a fair reading (a logo/infographic is a layout job that also carries text), so either one meets.
notes.N10: 'new pictures of him from reference photos' is reference_images by the declaration's own wording; character_consistency (keep the same dog) is an equally fair reading, so either meets.
notes.N7: A 4K product shot may also earn photoreal; that is an allowed extra. high_resolution is the one that must be present.
notes.Z-questions: A capability on these is noise: it would surface hosted single-model ecosystems for a request an add-on ecosystem answers.
